module: Flowgraph node "PointsBar Points" (category repeat_instant, ui color/icon). Sets the points and the label of the pointsBar UI app via ui_apps_pointsBar.setPoints(points, pointsLabel), then marks self.mgr.modules.ui.pointsBarChanged = true. Inputs: points (number, fill length of the bar) and pointsLabel (string, displayed text). Runs every frame it receives flow.

work.desc: Calls ui_apps_pointsBar.setPoints with the points and pointsLabel pins and signals the change to the flowgraph ui module.
